architecture.title: The improvement library — one per domain × executor, read before each task, appended after
architecture.caption: Each step reads the domain's library (INDEX.md first, then relevant entries), adapts proven components — re-verifying any workspace fact against the task's own evidence — and, after it commits, stores the whole adopted tree plus EXPERIENCE.md (edit rows, then at most one lesson or NO_ENTRY). Library.add refuses grader language. In the course's EXAMPLE design for Ops Assistant, tenant facts go to the knowledge graph, not to LongTermMEMORY.md. Course re-implementation on the SIM.

sequence.title: F1-CH40 at the second hotel — a 3.0 K fact copied unchecked
sequence.caption: Captured from Lab 05-3 (SIM, seed 0, reverify=False). The editor adapts the fault-review skill from the Harbour View entry; it carries 'approach limit 3.0 K'. The agent uses it on a 3.4 K approach and calls condenser fouling at a hotel whose manual says 4.5 K. The trajectory looks healthy, so no contrast flags it; bench.judge, after the step, scores 80. With reverify=True the fact becomes 4.5 K and the score is 100.
